name: application-skeleton-card-list
title: Skeleton Card List
description: Content-shaped shimmer placeholders composed into a card grid or list-row layout, matching the eventual content's structure rather than a single generic loading primitive.
useWhen: Loading a card grid or list where the final layout is known in advance, so the placeholder can match its shape and reduce perceived layout shift.
The load is expected to take long enough that a static spinner would feel less informative than a content-shaped placeholder.
avoidWhen: The content shape is unknown or highly variable — a single generic spinner communicates 'loading' without implying a layout that might not match.
The load is near-instant — skipping straight to content avoids an unnecessary flash of placeholder state.
Existing content is being refreshed in place — use a loading overlay instead, so the user keeps their prior context.
responsiveBehavior: The card grid variant uses a fixed 3-column grid matched to its container in the example; adjust the grid-cols utility to the real content's responsive breakpoints. The list-row variant is a single-column flex stack that works at any width.
accessibility: The container carries role="status" with an aria-label summarizing what's loading, plus a visually hidden sr-only text node, so screen readers announce the loading state once rather than reading each shimmer block.
Placeholder blocks themselves have no semantic content and are not individually announced — the single status label on the container is sufficient.
